extracted.intended_audience: readers (students, instructors, researchers) using Hatcher's Algebraic Topology (textbook)
extracted.subtask_description: Errata and clarifications for the textbook 'Algebraic Topology' by Allen Hatcher: specific corrections to notation, hypotheses, references, proofs, exercises, and exposition that affect correctness or clarity of the material.

rubrics_metrics.name: Join associativity/topology caveat
rubrics_metrics.description: Do not assert unconditionally that join is associative topologically; set-theoretically join is associative but topologies on (X * Y) * Z and X * (Y * Z) can differ.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explain that mixing product and quotient constructions can lead to bad point-set behavior; for CW complexes avoid the issue by using CW topologies (as in the text). Delete the sentence claiming easy associativity and change wording from 'regarded' to 'constructed'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Homotopy extension property: continuity hypothesis
rubrics_metrics.description: When proving continuity of a function defined on X × {0} ∪ A × I from its restrictions, one needs A closed in X to guarantee continuity in typical arguments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Most applications use A closed; the online version fixes the argument and the Appendix handles the trickier case when A is not closed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use quotient map hypothesis in glue/construction exercises
rubrics_metrics.description: In exercises or statements involving quotient identifications (e.g., natural map X → B ⊔_f X), require the attaching map f to be a quotient map rather than merely surjective to avoid point-set topology difficulties.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Add the quotient map hypothesis in relevant exercises (e.g., Chapter 0 Exercise 27) or show homotopy equivalence when (X,A) has the homotopy extension property.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assume Hausdorff where needed
rubrics_metrics.description: Add Hausdorff hypothesis to spaces where separation is used (e.g., Chapter 0, Exercise 21).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If a more general version is desired, give the precise general hypothesis (e.g., connected quotient space obtained by finite identifications of 2-spheres).

rubrics_metrics.name: Assume path-connectedness for covering/nerve decompositions
rubrics_metrics.description: Require X_α to be path-connected when claiming deformation retracts or when neighborhoods A_α retract onto them (Example 1.21).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Add explicit phrase that the X_α are path-connected, hence the neighborhoods A_α deformation retract onto them.

rubrics_metrics.name: Covering-space hypotheses: surjectivity of p
rubrics_metrics.description: When formulating exercises about covering spaces, require the covering map p to be surjective (e.g., §1.3, Exercise 3).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Add surjectivity hypothesis to avoid degenerate cases where p^{-1}(U_α) might be empty.

rubrics_metrics.name: Covering-space local path/endpoint technicalities
rubrics_metrics.description: Clarify in covering-space discussions that p^{-1}(U_α) can be empty and that 'four ends of edges' is more accurate than 'four edges meet' when edges may loop back to the same vertex.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Revise wording for precision and allow edges with both ends at the same vertex.

rubrics_metrics.name: Action of π1 on fibers: left vs right action
rubrics_metrics.description: Define the action of π1(X,x0) on fiber lifts carefully: the original defn produced a right action; to follow the book's left-action convention swap γ(0) and γ(1) in the definition.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fix exercise definitions (as done in updated online version) to ensure the action aligns with book convention; note that original definition yields left action only when π1 is abelian.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use discrete topology for certain fiber sets
rubrics_metrics.description: When regarding a fiber F as a set in covering-space arguments, treat F with the discrete topology where appropriate (e.g., §1.3 discussion around page 69-70).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explicitly state discrete topology for F in the paragraph that defines it as a space.

rubrics_metrics.name: Injectivity of edge homomorphisms in van Kampen–type exercises
rubrics_metrics.description: Add hypothesis that all edge homomorphisms are injective where van Kampen-like conclusions depend on it (e.g., §1.B, Exercise 9).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State injectivity requirement explicitly in the exercise statement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subspace quotient map property: require A closed
rubrics_metrics.description: If q: X→Y is a quotient map and B⊂Y a subspace, then the restriction q: A=q^{-1}(B)→B is a quotient map provided A is closed in X.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use saturated open-set arguments to justify; include the closure hypothesis when used in proofs (Chapter 0, Proposition 0.18 discussion).

rubrics_metrics.name: Notation consistency: composition dot for paths
rubrics_metrics.description: Use a dot to denote composition of paths (e.g., g1·g2) rather than juxtaposition in places where clarity is needed (e.g., §1.3, proof of Proposition 1.32).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Apply consistent notation for composition throughout the proof and exercises.

rubrics_metrics.name: Correct spelling and diacritics for names/references
rubrics_metrics.description: Use correct spellings/diacritics for names (e.g., Koenig → König, Macauley → Macaulay, Adam' → Adams).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Align with Bibliography and original sources.

rubrics_metrics.name: Local path-connectedness vs 0-LC distinction
rubrics_metrics.description: Do not confuse local path-connectedness with the weaker 0-local connectedness (0-LC); remove sentences that use the weaker notion if the stronger is intended.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Delete or rephrase sentences where the weaker condition was erroneously mentioned and is not used elsewhere.

rubrics_metrics.name: Covering projection family hypotheses in examples
rubrics_metrics.description: Specify assumptions like path-connected, locally path-connected, and semilocally simply-connected when invoking universal coverings or certain covering-space statements (e.g., §1.3 middle of page 69).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Add all three hypotheses explicitly when they are required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Add basepoint-dependence caveat for reduced suspension
rubrics_metrics.description: Note that reduced suspension depends on choice of basepoint; when claiming an identification, state 'with respect to a suitable choice of basepoint' (e.g., §1.2, comment on reduced suspension).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Make basepoint choice explicit to avoid ambiguity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exercise deletions when incorrect
rubrics_metrics.description: Remove/omit parts of exercises that are incorrect and cannot be fixed succinctly (e.g., §1.2, page 53, Exercise 5(b) is wrong and should be deleted; §2.2 Exercise 34 deleted).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Delete the incorrect part and, if possible, provide a corrected/revised exercise or explanation in the online version.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assume discrete subspace closed for simple proofs
rubrics_metrics.description: When an exercise's proof is simple under an extra hypothesis, add that hypothesis to keep the exercise accessible (e.g., §1.2, Exercise 6: add assumption that the discrete subspace of R^n is closed).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note that the result may hold more generally but with a more complicated proof.

rubrics_metrics.name: Orientation of triangle edges in simplicial examples
rubrics_metrics.description: When specifying orientation of edges in a triangle T with vertices P,Q,R, state the oriented edges as PQ, PR, QR.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Add this clarification in Exercise 15 to remove ambiguity in orientation conventions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clarify conventions in covering-space lifting statements
rubrics_metrics.description: Change phrasing 'paths lifting the constant path at x0' to 'paths lifting constant paths' to be concise and clear (§1.1, page 30).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use clearer phrasing consistently.

rubrics_metrics.name: References: correct theorem/corollary citations
rubrics_metrics.description: Fix numerous incorrect cross-references to theorems, propositions, corollaries, and exercises throughout the book (multiple specific locations).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Replace incorrect numbers with correct ones (e.g., §1.1 page 32: Corollary 2.15 not 2.11; §1.1 page 36: Theorem 2.26 not 2.19; §2.2 page 224 reference to Theorem 3.15 not 3.16; many others).

rubrics_metrics.name: Chain-map hypothesis for commutative diagram maps
rubrics_metrics.description: When presenting commutative diagrams involving short exact sequences and vertical maps α, β, γ, add hypothesis that these maps are chain maps (commute with boundary homomorphisms) if that was implicit.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Make chain-map property explicit for early small diagrams; later larger diagrams may already include boundary maps so no addition needed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Degree for maps S^n→S^n: exclude n=0
rubrics_metrics.description: Exclude n = 0 from the general definition of degree for S^n→S^n to avoid trivial/degenerate cases.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Add the nontriviality condition n>0 where necessary and point out the H_n conventions (tilde vs unreduced).

rubrics_metrics.name: Ensure homology groups H_n(S^n) denoted correctly
rubrics_metrics.description: When using H_n(S^n) in examples where reduced homology is intended, put the tilde (e.g., Example 2.23 occurrences).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fix notation in early printings; later printings corrected.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fix algebraic manipulations and indices in proofs
rubrics_metrics.description: Correct erroneous indices, signs, and algebraic expressions in displayed equations and proofs (e.g., change w_i,w_j ordering; S([w0]) equalities; change wi and wj to wj and wk; fix superscripts/subscripts in many places).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Update displayed equations to the corrected forms provided; consult online version for corrected paragraphs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Require identifications preserve ordering of vertices for quotient complex
rubrics_metrics.description: Make explicit that identifications in constructing a quotient simplicial complex should preserve vertex orderings to obtain a simplicial complex structure (Exercise 2 in §2.1).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State this explicitly even if implicit from goal of getting a complex structure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subdivision description clarified geometrically
rubrics_metrics.description: Revise the description of subdivision (Δ^n × I) to be more geometric and add clarifying words following Proposition 2.12.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use revised paragraph wording in later printings/online version for clarity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Small-cancellation identification of faces in cycles
rubrics_metrics.description: In the statement about cycles and face pairings, avoid wording 'exactly two' when two faces in a canceling pair could be faces of the same simplex; instead say (n−1)-faces are identified in pairs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Replace problematic sentence with 'If ξ is a cycle, all the (n−1)-dimensional faces are identified in pairs.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Orientation for boundary homomorphism sign conventions
rubrics_metrics.description: Fix sign and index typos in boundary/cochain formulas and ensure consistency in signs in proofs involving cup products, cohomology operations, and coproduct formulas (numerous places: §3.1, §3.C, §4.L, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adopt corrected formulas as listed in errata and the online version; watch for graded-commutativity sign conventions in Hopf algebra coproducts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Add semi-local statements in lemma expansions
rubrics_metrics.description: Expand lemmas where necessary to add missing surjectivity or other properties (e.g., Lemma 2.34 expanded to state map H_k(X^n)→H_k(X) is surjective when k=n).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include the expanded statements and revised proofs in later printings/online version.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use semicolons in coefficient notation consistently
rubrics_metrics.description: Use C_ℓ(X; R) and H^n(X; R) notation with semicolon for coefficients rather than comma (e.g., §3.2, §3.1 corrections).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Replace commas with semicolons in cohomology/homology coefficient notations across the text for consistency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assume finite-dimensional CW structures where needed
rubrics_metrics.description: Add hypothesis that CW structures are finite-dimensional in exercises/statements that require it (e.g., §3.C Exercise 1 / §3.C earlier corrections).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explicitly require finite-dimensionality when used to justify conclusions.

rubrics_metrics.name: When using cohomology rings as invariants, note coefficient restrictions
rubrics_metrics.description: State when results about cohomology rings determining complexes hold (e.g., CX uniquely determined by H^*(X;Z) — true even with Z_2 coefficients; references given).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Mention the proven results and references (e.g., Gubeladze 1998) and any coefficient specifics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Correct history/math theorem statements (division algebra dimension)
rubrics_metrics.description: Fix historical/theorem statements: Frobenius needs identity element hypothesis; Hurwitz proved |ab|=|a||b| implies dimension 1,2,4,8 (not the full classification).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Replace paragraph with revised historical commentary and references (Ebbinghaus 1991; Bott & Milnor 1958; Kervaire 1958).

rubrics_metrics.name: Fix point-set topology gaps in Mayer–Vietoris hints
rubrics_metrics.description: Avoid hints that lead to point-set topology problems; provide corrected hints that glue copies of (D^n,D) to ends and use Mayer–Vietoris for complements (e.g., §2.B Exercise 3).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide hints that respect point-set hypotheses and clarify construction steps.

rubrics_metrics.name: Correct references between sections (e.g., 2C.3 → 4L.4)
rubrics_metrics.description: Change incorrect cross-references between section/exercise numbers to the correct ones (e.g., §2.C line pre-proof reference to Example 4L.4 not an exercise in 4K).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Systematically update cross-references according to errata.

rubrics_metrics.name: Coproduct formula corrections in Hopf algebras / graded tensor products
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide careful definition of coproduct on tensor products of Hopf algebras, including the map ordering that interchanges middle factors and includes graded-commutativity signs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Replace insufficiently careful explanations with composition of maps (A⊗B) → (A⊗A)⊗(B⊗B) → (A⊗B)⊗(A⊗B) and include usual signs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assume associativity up to homotopy for H–space multiplication in exercises
rubrics_metrics.description: Add hypothesis that H–space multiplication is associative up to homotopy where exercise conclusions depend on it (e.g., §3.C, Exercise 3).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include this assumption explicitly in the exercise statement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Add connectivity/finite-dimensional assumptions in exercises on cohomology/homotopy
rubrics_metrics.description: Add connectivity (X connected) or finite-dimensional assumptions to exercises/statements as needed (multiple locations: §3.C Exercise 9 add X connected; §3.H Exercise 6 add X finite-dimensional).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Amend exercise statements to include these hypotheses and explain necessity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Finite-dimensionality of certain structures (CW, complexes) in examples
rubrics_metrics.description: Specify 'finite-dimensional' where the argument requires it (e.g., §3.C line 16 insert 'finite-dimensional' before 'CW structure').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Add the adjective to prevent misuse in infinite-dimensional settings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fix typos involving fonts, punctuation, and parenthesis in formulas
rubrics_metrics.description: Correct many small typographical issues (missing period, misplaced parentheses, wrong font for symbols, missing semicolons in Hom groups, blackboard bold letters, etc.) throughout the book.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Apply typographical corrections listed in errata (examples across chapters: many lines).

rubrics_metrics.name: Correct Poincaré duality/cohomology-with-compact-supports technicalities
rubrics_metrics.description: Do not assert inclusion maps of open sets are proper generally; in Poincaré duality proofs use induced maps of the correct sort (maps H^i_c(V;G) associated to inclusions U ↪ V in fixed manifold M).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Revise the paragraph and diagrams accordingly; correct arrow directions in diagrams where needed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fill missing steps in cohomological cocycle replacement arguments
rubrics_metrics.description: When a cocycle δϕ_A represents δ[ϕ] in H^*(M,A+B) rather than H^*(M,A∪B), include the missing step of replacing δϕ_A by δϕ_A+δψ for some ψ to obtain a cocycle in C^*(M,A∪B).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Show how to replace ϕ_A and ϕ_B by ϕ_A+ψ and ϕ_B+ψ to obtain desired cocycle; include this correction in proof of Poincaré Duality.

rubrics_metrics.name: Strengthen conditions for Corollary 3.39 generator hypothesis
rubrics_metrics.description: In Corollary 3.39 require that α generate an infinite cyclic summand of H^k(M;Z) (stronger than just infinite order and not a proper multiple).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explain with counterexamples (e.g., Z×Z_p) and update statement accordingly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Symmetric bilinear form realizability caveat
rubrics_metrics.description: Note that the claim 'every symmetric nonsingular bilinear form occurs as cup-product pairing in a closed simply-connected manifold with minimal homology' is true only in dimensions 4,8,16; in other dimensions only even forms are realizable with minimal homology.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Add this caveat and mention that non-even forms may be realizable with nonminimal homology; clarify open questions where appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Homological/cohomological index corrections in many displayed formulae
rubrics_metrics.description: Fix incorrect superscripts/subscripts, exponents, and indices in displayed formulas and exercise statements (examples: change superscript i+j on x to subscript; exponent corrections in §3.2 Exercise 14, §4.L exponent corrections).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Implement the listed specific corrections and verify related formulae for consistency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Correct wedge/Ω-spectrum cohomology association caveat
rubrics_metrics.description: Defining h^i(X) = lim→ h^{n}(X∧K_n) may fail wedge axiom for infinite wedges; to avoid, associate the Ω-spectrum to the given spectrum and take cohomology of that Ω-spectrum.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note that finite wedges are OK; revise exposition to explain the fix and consequences.

rubrics_metrics.name: CW approximation uniqueness up to homotopy
rubrics_metrics.description: Add argument that CW approximations are unique up to homotopy equivalence and remove the redundant later corollary.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Add a short uniqueness proof on page noted and revise cross-references.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cellular Approximation deformation detail
rubrics_metrics.description: In the Cellular Approximation subsection clarify that deformations of f on e^k to make f(e^k) miss a point will not make f(e^k) intersect any more cells than before.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Insert the clarification when discussing the deformation step.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fix coset indexing in relative π1 notation
rubrics_metrics.description: When using π1(X,A,x0) with the book's convention of paths from points in A to x0, use coset notation Hα not αH (Exercise 5 p.358).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explain which path-direction convention is in use and choose coset order accordingly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Replace 'weakly homotopy equivalent' nuance
rubrics_metrics.description: In Exercise 22 add 'weakly' before 'homotopy equivalent' where only weak equivalence was intended.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Make the weaker notion explicit to avoid misuse of 'homotopy equivalent'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fix large-diagram commutativity up to sign
rubrics_metrics.description: Note that certain large diagrams only commute up to sign unless generators are chosen carefully; for many purposes up-to-sign is fine, but document the generator choice exercise.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Mention the issue in the text and optionally give an exercise to choose generators for exact commutativity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Hurewicz theorem proof reworking
rubrics_metrics.description: The proof of the general Hurewicz theorem has been rewritten; use the revised proof in later printings/online version.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Refer readers to updated proof (pages indicated) for corrected argument.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fix stable homotopy stems chart errors
rubrics_metrics.description: Replace incorrect 2-primary stable homotopy groups chart (above dimension ~50) with corrected calculations (Isaksen et al.); update accompanying text where necessary.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the corrected online chart and update textual commentary on pages 385-388.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exercise corrections involving π_n/relative groups placement
rubrics_metrics.description: Move or relabel exercises to appropriate sections when they belong to earlier definitions (e.g., some exercises about relative homotopy groups belong in §4.1 rather than §4.2).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Relocate problems to correct sections or add remark about placement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fix multiple occurrence typos in Section and Appendix references
rubrics_metrics.description: Correct many section/chapter cross-reference typos (e.g., Introduction to Ch.3 'homology group' → 'cohomology group'; Appendix references A.9 vs A.10).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Apply the specific replacements listed in the errata.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix: local compactness definition clarity
rubrics_metrics.description: State the working definition of local compactness used: each neighborhood of each point contains a compact neighborhood (stronger than 'each point has at least one compact neighborhood'), and note equivalence for Hausdorff spaces.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include remark in Appendix to avoid confusion with alternate definitions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix: add homotopy extension property section corrections
rubrics_metrics.description: In the added Appendix section on Homotopy Extension Property, change references (Chapter 1 → Chapter 0) and fix misspellings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include corrected references and spelling fixes; show the added section's first lines as corrected.

rubrics_metrics.name: Index corrections
rubrics_metrics.description: Update Index entries to add or correct page numbers (cup product add page 206; Hurewicz theorem first pages 366 and 371; projective space: quaternion first ref page 222 not 214).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Apply index adjustments to match corrected positions in the text.

rubrics_metrics.name: Caveat about Poincaré Duality with local coefficients
rubrics_metrics.description: In statement of Theorem 3H.6 (Poincaré duality with local coefficients), change second (or third) occurrence of M_R to R (ordinary coefficients) to reflect intended usage; see separate correction page for details.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clarify which factor uses local coefficients vs ordinary coefficients and refer to correction page for full details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fix claims about H^1 with group-ring coefficients
rubrics_metrics.description: The claim 'H^1(X; Z[π_1 X]) is an infinite direct sum of Z' is false in general; it holds only when π1(X) is free on two or more generators. For π1 infinite cyclic the cohomology is a single Z.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Amend statements/exercises to include the π1 hypothesis or correct the conclusion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Add hypothesis on edge homomorphism indices in chain tensor equations
rubrics_metrics.description: Delete an incorrect coefficient (−1)^i in displayed tensor equations near bottom of §3.B (fix specific coefficient placement).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Apply the precise coefficient deletions/replacements listed in errata.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fix errors in Steenrod/Adem relation proofs
rubrics_metrics.description: Correct sign mistakes and add arguments where necessary in proofs about Steenrod operations and Adem relations (e.g., add argument for additivity of Sq^i, correct Lemma 4L.14 signs).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use corrected proofs as given in the online version; anticipate page breaks changed by corrections.
